title: Your team's onboarding
intro: We are building the new onboarding for your team. Your answers decide what we build first.
purpose: Plan the first release of the onboarding.
context: Today a new user gets one welcome email and a link to the help center. **About half** of new users never finish their profile.

items.q: Who sets up a new account at your company?
opts: An admin, for the whole team
One person sets up many accounts.

items.q: Where do new users get stuck today?
items.why: We want to fix the step that costs the most, not the step we can see.
items.guess: At the step that connects the calendar. Most support tickets are about it.

items.q: How do you want to reach a new user in the first week?
opts: Works without the user opening the app.

items.q: What must a new user be able to do at the end of the first week?
items.why: This becomes the goal we measure the onboarding against.
